cards.name: Chain Heal

cards.name: Healing Wave
cards.desc: Cheap single-target heal. When 1-2 people are hurt or to save mana

cards.name: Healing Surge
cards.desc: Fast single-target heal. Mana-expensive, so emergencies only

cards.name: Nature's Swiftness
cards.desc: Next Nature spell is instant and free, plus 1 Stormstream Totem. Use on cooldown (Farseer gets Ancestral Swiftness instead)

cards.name: Ancestral Swiftness

cards.name: Lava Burst
cards.desc: Main attack for DPS time. Always crits on targets with Flame Shock

cards.desc: Damage DoT. Enables Lava Burst crits

cards.name: Chain Lightning
cards.desc: Multi-target damage filler

cards.name: Healing Tide Totem
cards.desc: Heals the whole party for 10 sec. 2 min via First Ascendant (Totemic build)

cards.name: Ascendance
cards.desc: Greatly empowers Chain Heal and Healing Wave for 15 sec (18 sec with Preeminence) (Farseer build)

cards.name: Spirit Link Totem
cards.desc: 10% damage reduction and health redistribution for 6 sec. Right before a big hit, or to save one person in an emergency

cards.name: Spiritwalker's Grace
cards.desc: Cast while moving for 15 sec. For forced-movement phases

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.desc: 30% party Haste for 40 sec. Alliance uses Heroism

cards.name: Purify Spirit
cards.desc: Removes magic and curses (Improved Purify Spirit). 8 sec cooldown

cards.name: Poison Cleansing Totem
cards.desc: Every 1.5 sec for 6 sec, removes all poisons from one ally within 30 yards. 2 min cooldown

cards.name: Purge
cards.desc: Removes one beneficial magic effect from an enemy

cards.name: Earth Shield
cards.desc: Keep on yourself and the tank. Increases your healing by 20% and heals when damage is taken (Elemental Orbit)

cards.name: Astral Shift
cards.desc: 40% less damage taken for 12 sec. 1 min 30 sec cooldown (Planes Traveler)

cards.name: Nature's Guardian
cards.desc: Dropping below 35% health instantly heals 40% (passive)

cards.name: Wind Barrier
cards.desc: While you have a totem out, a shield absorbing 6% of your health every 30 sec (Totemic build)

cards.name: Wind Shear
cards.desc: The only healer interrupt. 12 sec cooldown

cards.name: Capacitor Totem
cards.desc: Stuns enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec after 2 sec. Stops grouped adds' casts

cards.name: Ghost Wolf
cards.desc: Movement speed increase. Removes slows via Thunderous Paws

cards.name: Gust of Wind
cards.desc: Short forward leap

cards.name: Wind Rush Totem
cards.desc: 40% movement speed for allies passing through. 1 min 30 sec cooldown (Ascending Air)

cards.name: Totemic Projection
cards.desc: Moves your placed totems to a target location. 10 sec cooldown

cards.name: Ancestral Spirit
cards.desc: Out-of-combat resurrection

cards.name: Reincarnation
cards.desc: Resurrect yourself on death. Once per 30 min

cards.name: Water Shield
cards.desc: Mana-restoring shield. Keep it up at all times

cards.name: Earthliving Weapon
cards.desc: Weapon imbue. Riptide, Healing Wave, and Chain Heal trigger Earthliving

cards.name: Tidecaller's Guard
cards.desc: Shield imbue. 2% more healing, Healing Stream Totem lasts 3 sec longer (Totemic build)

cards.name: Skyfury

cards.name: Tidal Waves
cards.desc: 1 stack per Riptide; your next Healing Wave or Chain Heal cast time is reduced by 20%

sections.title: 6. Maintenance buffs
sections.html:
Put Earth Shield on both yourself and the tank via Elemental Orbit. Therazane's Resilience keeps its charges from dropping, so just check it every hour (and after dying). Keep Water Shield, Earthliving Weapon, and Tidecaller's Guard up at all times. With Instinctive Imbuements, casting Water Shield also applies your weapon imbue and Earth Shield (Wowhead).

Tidal Waves stacks with each Riptide and speeds up your next Healing Wave or Chain Heal. The Stormstream Totem buff lasts 60 sec and stacks up to 2, so you can hold it until right before big damage (Wowhead).

  1. ESC → Options → Gameplay Enhancements → Advanced Cooldown Settings → Buffs tab: move Tidal Waves and Stormstream Totem into the Tracked Bars section. In the Tracked Buffs section, the bars don't show a timer.
  2. Earth Shield and Water Shield are 1-hour buffs, so put them in the Tracked Buffs section and just watch for them dropping.

383013.d: 발 밑에 토템을 소환하여 6초 동안 1.5초마다 30미터 내에 있는 주위의 파티원 또는 공격대원의 독 효과를 모두 제거합니다.

443454.d:
다음 치유 또는 공격 주문이 즉시 시전되고 마나를 소모하지 않으며, 공격력과 치유량이 10%만큼 증가합니다.

자연의 신속함을 배웠을 경우 선조의 신속함으로 대체됩니다. 추가로 선조의 신속함이 8초 동안 곁에 선조를 소환합니다.

444995.m: 특성 · 6.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간
444995.d:
대상 위치에 토템을 소환하여 25초 동안 효과가 10%만큼 증가한 치유의 비를 시전하게 합니다.

치유의 비를 대체합니다.

445031.d: 토템이 활성화되어 있으면 토템이 30초마다 30초 동안 (총 생명력 * 6 / 100)의 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 부여합니다.

457481.d: 1시간 동안 방패에 물의 정기를 주입합니다. 치유량이 2.0%만큼, 치유의 토템의 지속시간이 3.0초만큼 증가합니다.

462854.d:
바람의 군주의 분노를 이용해 1시간 동안 대상 아군의 특화를 2%만큼 증가시키고 자동 공격 시 20%의 확률로 즉시 다시 한번 공격을 가하게 합니다.

대상이 같은 파티나 공격대에 속해 있다면, 모든 파티원과 공격대원이 효과를 받습니다. (효과 발동 확률: 20%, 100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

470411.m: 0.3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 6 초 재사용 대기시간
470411.d:
대상을 불로 그을려 (주문력의 22.425%)의 화산 피해를 입히고, 추가로 18초에 걸쳐 총 (주문력의 120.06%)의 화산 피해를 입힙니다.

최대 6명의 대상에게 화염 충격을 부여할 수 있습니다.

1267068.m: 1.8% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
1267068.d: 발밑에 토템을 소환하여 즉시 2명의 부상당한 아군을 (주문력의 1323%)만큼 치유하고, 추가로 40미터 내의 부상당한 아군 2명을 15초 동안 2초마다 (주문력의 67.68%)만큼 치유합니다.
